How to play

  1. Aim — drag left/right anywhere on the course. Tap the map button (or the mini-map) for a top-down view and tap where you want to go.
  2. Club — pick one from the bottom bar; the number is its full carry in yards.
  3. Swing — tap the big button to start, tap again to set power (the white mark shows what reaches the pin), then tap to strike.
  4. Strike zones — green = pure. Blue = draw (curves left), orange = fade (curves right). Miss them for a hook or slice.
  5. Spin — while the ball is in the air, drag: down = backspin (stops quick), up = topspin (runs out), sideways bends it. Each club learns spin as it levels: topspin at Lv 2, sidespin at Lv 4, backspin at Lv 5.
  6. Greens — reading them is a putter skill. Putter Lv 1: no help. Lv 2: a straight aim arrow. Lv 3: flowing arrows show which way it slopes. Lv 5: colours show how steep (red = steep) within 10 yds of your ball, plus the start of the dotted break line. Lv 7: the whole green and the full break line.
  7. Lies — rough, sand and driver off the deck cost power and control. Water is a one-stroke penalty.
  8. Power — the power marker is slowest (easiest) through the middle of the bar and quickest near empty and full. Full-power swings also shrink the strike zones and speed up the strike marker, and the very top of the bar is a little less repeatable.
  9. Part swings — under about 85% power, distance and strike get less reliable (wedges are designed for it). A low chip with the 5i, 7W or hybrid from near the green is an easy bump-and-run.
  10. Club levels — every shot earns XP for that club (forgiving clubs like the 7 wood learn fastest; the driver and long irons slowest, the 0 iron slowest of all). Levels 1–10 take distance, accuracy and spin from 90% up to 110%, and unlock special shots: Knock-down (Lv 3), Flop with SW/LW (Lv 4), Draw/Fade (Lv 6), Chip with the 7 iron from any lie within 60 yds (Lv 5), Power drive with DR/3W (Lv 8). Tap the shot-type button above your clubs to pick one. New levels kick in from the next hole. New golfers start with the 5W, 7W, 4H, 7i and PW and earn the rest: 3 Wood (5W Lv 3) → Mini Driver (3W Lv 3) → Driver (Mini Lv 4); 3 Hybrid (4H or 5W Lv 3); 5 Iron (7i Lv 3) → 2 & 4 Iron (5i Lv 3); Sand & Lob Wedge (PW Lv 3) — and for the dedicated, the 1 Iron (2i Lv 6) and the legendary 0 Iron (1i Lv 8).
  11. Trees — they're solid. Trunks knock the ball back; leafy branches swallow it and drop it underneath. Go over or around.
  12. Firm greens — woods and long irons skip through fast greens; wedges and the 7 wood hold them.
